note: Non-authoritative projection of the source-controlled Volume 12 Package 3 corpus. Confers no ratification and authorizes no implementation, evidence acceptance, system release, or production.

program_gate_matrix.title: Integrated program-gate matrix, criteria, authority, and escalation
program_gate_matrix.statement: The complete gate hierarchy from definition through execution, evidence intake, acceptance, release authorization, deployment, and stabilization, recording each gate's criteria, evidence, decisions, authority, independence, dispositions, blocking conditions, and escalation route.
program_gate_matrix.prohibited_inference: Earlier gate passed is not later gate passed, and definition gate is not execution authorization.

gate_evidence_requirements.title: Gate-entry evidence requirement
gate_evidence_requirements.statement: The requirement that every gate in the program-gate matrix name the evidence and decisions required to enter it, without asserting that any such evidence exists.
gate_evidence_requirements.prohibited_inference: Earlier gate passed is not later gate passed.
